_comment: Coordinates are mean-Earth/polar-axis frame, east longitude 0-360. Values come from the research report's table (NASA Lunar Surface Data Book 2025 region centres; LROC fixes for landers). Region centres are reference points, not landing ellipses. VERIFY each against its source before quoting it in the submission.
